name: carouselcn
summary: Copy-paste carousel components and examples for React and Tailwind CSS with drag, loop, vertical and autoplay modes.
description: A carousel and motion carousel for React and Tailwind CSS, built on the shadcn/ui copy-paste philosophy. Features drag/swipe and keyboard support, looping, vertical orientation, autoplay, custom indicators and composable sub-components, with no animation library required (CSS transitions only). The docs include testimonial, image gallery and autoplay gallery examples.
contains: examples: testimonials, image gallery, autoplay gallery
drag/swipe, loop, vertical and autoplay modes
no animation library; CSS transitions only
installs from a shadcn registry (2 items) or by copying the code
